Tidy table of peptide-level results

Source: R/reporting.R
hdx_results_table.Rd

One row per peptide, time point and compared pair of states, with the means, SDs, replicate counts, difference, Welch p-value, adjusted p-value, critical interval and significance call - the package-wide rule (p < pvalue AND |difference| > pooled CI). Suitable for supplementary tables and for further analysis outside HDXBoxeR. The analysis parameters, package version and date are attached as attribute "hdxboxer"; with file, the table is written as csv together with a <file>_parameters.txt holding the parameters and sessionInfo().

Usage

hdx_results_table(
  filepath,
  states,
  times,
  reference,
  all_pairs = FALSE,
  alpha = 0.01,
  pvalue = 0.01,
  p_adjust = "none",
  percent = FALSE,
  replicates = NULL,
  file = NULL
)

Arguments

filepath

input file or table, as for output_tp().

states

states to compare. Default: all.

times

time points. Default: all.

reference

reference state; every other state is compared with it (difference = other - reference). Default: the first state. reference = NULL or all_pairs = TRUE compares every pair.

all_pairs

TRUE compares every pair of states instead.

alpha

alpha of the pooled critical interval. Default 0.01.

pvalue

p-value cutoff. Default 0.01.

p_adjust

multiple-testing correction passed to stats::p.adjust(): "none" (default) or e.g. "BH", across the peptides of each pair of states at each time point.

percent

value scale as in output_tp(): FALSE (Da, default), TRUE, "FD" or "per_residue".

replicates

optional maximum number of replicates per state.

file

optional csv file to write.

Value

data frame (invisibly when file is given).

See also

hdx_summary_table(), output_prep()

Examples

file_nm <- system.file("extdata", "All_results_table.csv", package = "HDXBoxeR")
res <- hdx_results_table(file_nm)
head(res[res$is_sig, ])
